scratch_up.action: lifting one hind leg up off the ground and reaching it forward to scratch behind its ear, head tilting toward the leg

sniff_down.action: lowering its head all the way down until its snout touches the ground, front legs splaying forward and rear staying up

bounce.action: crouching down low then springing straight up off the ground with all four legs tucked up under its body

roll.action: tipping over sideways onto its back with all four legs sticking up in the air and waving

idle_breathe.note: blink frames removed; blink is idle_blink flourish only

play_chase.action: trotting forward quickly, legs reaching and pushing off in a fast run cycle
play_chase.note: 8 frames, not 6: locomotion is the one exception to the house frame count, because a gait has four contacts and six frames cannot hold four contacts plus their passing poses. Same reasoning as walk.

play_bounce.action: crouching down then jumping straight up off the ground with all four legs tucked under it, and landing back down
play_bounce.note: Regenerated on the house recipe: 6 frames, idle pose pinned as both first and last frame. Marked airborne so the build does not re-ground the hop away.

trick_sit.note: Regenerated on the house recipe: 6 frames, idle pose pinned as both first and last frame.

trick_dance.action: hopping from side to side on its hind legs, leaning left then right, then landing square

walk_letter.action: walking forward in a steady side-view walk cycle, legs stepping contact-pass-contact, body bobbing one pixel, curly tail swinging, while firmly holding the white heart-sealed envelope in its mouth the entire time so the letter never drops or changes shape
walk_letter.note: 8-frame gait with idle_letter frame-00 pinned as both first and last frame, so the walk loops on the letter-holding pose and the intro can play this instead of bare walk when a note is ready.
